blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s dentist, Dr. Lourdes Lebosada, said to be a former co-owner of controversial banana chips company Cale88 Foods Corp., is expected to take the stand when her Senate impeachment trial resumes next week. Public prosecutor and Bicol Saro Rep. Terry Ridon shared with the media a copy of the defense team’s list of next witnesses, which showed that Duterte’s lawyers had asked the impeachment court to subpoena Lebosada along with Bureau of Customs Deputy Commissioner Agaton Teodoro Uvero.
